description: Source code for URL utility functions in Chromium project, including URL parsing, modification, and validation functions.

classes.name: QueryIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for URL query parameters, allowing traversal and retrieval of key-value pairs.

methods.name: AppendQueryParameter
methods.description: Appends a query parameter to a URL.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceQueryParameter
methods.description: Adds or replaces a query parameter in a URL.

methods.name: AppendOrReplaceRef
methods.description: Adds or replaces the URL fragment (ref).

methods.name: QueryIterator::QueryIterator
methods.description: Constructor for QueryIterator, initializes iteration over URL query parameters.

methods.name: QueryIterator::~QueryIterator
methods.description: Destructor for QueryIterator.

methods.name: QueryIterator::GetKey
methods.description: Returns the current query parameter key.

methods.name: QueryIterator::GetValue
methods.description: Returns the current query parameter value.

methods.name: QueryIterator::GetUnescapedValue
methods.description: Returns the unescaped value of the current query parameter.

methods.name: QueryIterator::IsAtEnd
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has reached the end.

methods.name: QueryIterator::Advance
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next query parameter.

methods.name: GetValueForKeyInQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific key in URL query parameters.

methods.name: ParseHostAndPort
methods.description: Parses host and port from a string input.

methods.name: GetHostAndPort
methods.description: Returns host and port as a string from a URL.

methods.name: GetHostAndOptionalPort
methods.description: Returns host with optional port if specified.

methods.name: GetHostOrSpecFromURL
methods.description: Returns host or full URL string if host is absent.

methods.name: GetSuperdomain
methods.description: Extracts the superdomain from a domain string.

methods.name: IsSubdomainOf
methods.description: Checks if one domain is a subdomain of another.

methods.name: CanonicalizeHost
methods.description: Converts a host string into its canonical form.

methods.name: IsCanonicalizedHostCompliant
methods.description: Checks if a host string complies with canonicalization rules.

methods.name: IsHostnameNonUnique
methods.description: Determines if a hostname is non-unique (e.g., reserved or private).

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to localhost.

methods.name: HostStringIsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if a host string is localhost.

methods.name: SimplifyUrlForRequest
methods.description: Removes user info and ref from URL for request purposes.

methods.name: ChangeWebSocketSchemeToHttpScheme
methods.description: Converts ws/wss URL schemes to http/https.

methods.name: IsStandardSchemeWithNetworkHost
methods.description: Checks if a scheme is standard with network host.

methods.name: GetIdentityFromURL
methods.description: Extracts username and password from URL.

methods.name: HasGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if URL host is a Google domain.

methods.name: IsGoogleHost
methods.description: Checks if a host is a Google domain.

methods.name: IsGoogleHostWithAlpnH3
methods.description: Checks if host is google.com or www.google.com (case-insensitive).

methods.name: IsLocalHostname
methods.description: Checks if hostname is localhost or localhost TLD.

methods.name: UnescapePercentEncodedUrl
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded URL string, replacing '+' with space.
